description: This file defines classes and methods for creating and managing window specifications in PySpark's DataFrame API, including Window and WindowSpec classes with methods for partitioning, ordering, and frame boundaries.

classes.name: Window
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods and constants for defining window functions in DataFrames.

classes.name: WindowSpec
classes.description: Class representing a window specification that defines partitioning, ordering, and frame boundaries.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Creates a WindowSpec with specified partitioning columns.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Creates a WindowSpec with specified ordering columns.

methods.name: rowsBetween
methods.description: Defines frame boundaries based on row positions relative to the current row.

methods.name: rangeBetween
methods.description: Defines frame boundaries based on value ranges relative to the current row.
